description: This is an HTML file for a web-based database visualization tool, providing UI elements and embedded JavaScript for interacting with database data and displaying it in tabular form.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders a data array into an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on its value and type.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses large cell content for readability.
